title: Agent evaluation moves toward end-to-end task success
summary: Teams are evaluating agents on task completion, recovery, cost, and safe escalation rather than isolated model answers.
tpm_takeaway: Track autonomy tool-call success guardrails and human escalation—not just model quality.
recommended_action: TPM action: define a task-success scorecard with failure categories and owners.

title: Serving stacks emphasize lower time to first token
summary: New serving approaches focus on prefill/decode efficiency batching cache use and predictable tail latency.
tpm_takeaway: Translate the change into latency throughput reliability and cost-per-request impact.
recommended_action: TPM action: baseline TTFT ITL p95 latency throughput and cost before changing the stack.

title: Continuous evaluation becomes a release gate
summary: Production AI teams increasingly connect offline evaluation canaries observability and rollback criteria.
tpm_takeaway: Treat repeatability observability rollback and evaluation gates as delivery requirements.
recommended_action: TPM action: add measurable evaluation thresholds to release acceptance criteria.

title: Accelerator choice shifts toward workload price performance
summary: Teams are comparing complete software stacks and real workload economics rather than peak hardware specifications.
tpm_takeaway: Validate software compatibility and price/performance on your real workload before committing.
recommended_action: TPM action: require an apples-to-apples benchmark matrix and reproducibility notes.

title: Agent security expands beyond prompt injection
summary: Risk programs now cover tool permissions data exfiltration memory poisoning and unsafe autonomous actions.
tpm_takeaway: Add the new risk to acceptance criteria red-team coverage and release governance.
recommended_action: TPM action: document least privilege approval boundaries and incident response.
